Floris van Doorn and I are organising a one-week summer school on metaprogramming in Bonn, April 19 to 23, 2027. Lean has rich and powerful tooling to help automating tedious proofs, or checks you would like to delegate to a computer --- but this metaprogramming has a steep learning curve. This summer school contributes to sharing this knowledge better.

Our planned format is similar to Lean for the Curious Mathematician, but adapted to metaprogramming: there will be lecture series by metaprogramming experts, accompanied by practice sessions, and group projects mentored by more experienced metaprogrammers. We will share a more detailed list of topics closer to the event.

The event will take place at the Hausdorff Institute in Bonn, nicely located in the centre of Bonn.

If you already have some experience with formalization, and want to learn metaprogramming in addition, you're just our target audience and we welcome your application! Applications are open until December 18.
Our webpage includes further information and instructions for how to apply. We can cover accommodation, but travel costs only in some cases (e.g., PhD students or via the Global Mobility Fellowships).
